verdict.rationale: Bruno lets teams write and publish collection docs as shareable HTML and embed 'open in Bruno' buttons in READMEs, and its Git-native storage enables shared, discoverable collections across a repo/monorepo — a lightweight substitute for a catalog. However there is no dedicated internal developer-portal, no searchable catalog UI, and no cloud-hosted discovery surface (explicitly no cloud sync/account). missing for 10: a true portal/catalog UI, cross-team search/discovery beyond Git repos, hosted publishing beyond static HTML docs.
